lock.title: Everest Leaderboard
lock.subtitle: Sign in to view the board
lock.staysSignedIn: This device stays signed in after the first login — the display screen will not ask again.

report.hint: Pick a report type and period, then print to PDF or download as Excel.
report.noneAtRisk: Nobody below the threshold — the whole team is on track

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: No notifications yet. Every new deal and congratulation shows up here.
notifications.replay: Replay the celebration on this screen

empty.teamsBody: Waiting for the first results this quarter. Standings appear here as soon as sales are recorded.
empty.agentsBody: Waiting for the first results this quarter. Agents appear here as soon as sales are recorded.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoHint: Follows the clock: daylight from {from}:00 to {to}:00
settings.shortcuts: Shortcuts: T view · R rotate · F fullscreen · S settings · L language

chart.noHistory: Not enough history yet — a snapshot is taken daily.
chart.trendSub: Each team’s total sales, from the daily snapshots
chart.compareSub: Each team’s total sales per quarter
chart.trendHint: Use the left and right arrow keys to step through dates

admin.title: Board admin
admin.notAdmin: You do not have access to this page
admin.notAdminHint: {email} is signed in but is not an admin. Ask an admin to upgrade your account.
admin.activeHint: Inactive records leave the board without losing their data
admin.periodsHint: Edit the numbers, then press Save — nothing is written before that.
admin.confirmDeleteTeam: Permanently delete team “{name}”? Its agents are kept but left without a team.
admin.confirmDeleteAgent: Permanently delete agent “{name}”? All their targets and sales go with them. Deactivating is usually better.
admin.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 2 MB
admin.demoHint: Browse every tab, view reports and download Excel files. Saving, deleting, uploading photos and sending celebrations are disabled for this account.
admin.celebrateTitle: Show a celebration on the screens
admin.celebrateHint: Appears full-screen right away on every open board — including the office display — and is logged in notifications. New deals are celebrated automatically; this is for manual congratulations.
admin.celebrateDone: Done — the celebration for {name} is showing on every open screen.
admin.exportHint: A file with Teams and Agents sheets covering the whole year. Same columns as the Google Sheet, so it can be uploaded there as-is.
admin.importHint: Updates existing rows and adds new ones, matched by name — nothing is ever deleted. A file missing someone will not remove them.
admin.photoType: Unsupported format — use JPG, PNG or WebP
admin.changePasswordHint: At least 6 characters. Checked against a leaked-password database before saving.
admin.passwordTooShort: Password is too short — at least 6 characters
admin.passwordPwned: This password has appeared in {count} known data breaches — choose a different one
admin.passwordCheckFailed: Couldn't check the password against the leak database (connection issue) — proceed at your own risk or try again later
admin.leadsHint: Pick from the agents — a team can have several managers and supervisors; supervisors are optional.
admin.leadsSame: The same person can't be both manager and supervisor of a team
admin.transferHint: Moving an agent to another team doesn't change their current team's numbers: sales so far and this quarter's target stay with it, and new sales count for the new team.

storage.title: Storage used
storage.hint: Supabase database and photo usage, plus the GitHub code repository. Warning at 70%, critical at 90%.

alert.warn: Storage use passed 70% — take a backup and free up space soon.
alert.critical: Storage almost full (over 90%) — back up and free space now to keep the board fast.

storage.suggestBackup: Last backup: {when}. A monthly backup is recommended.
storage.suggestCleanup: After backing up, remove old notifications, snapshots and unused photos under “Free up space”.

meterHint.db: Numbers, notifications and daily snapshots. Free plan limit 500MB.
meterHint.files: Uploaded team and agent photos. Free plan limit 1GB.
meterHint.github: Code only; size is nearly constant. Recommended limit 1GB.

storage.githubUnavailable: Could not read the repository size right now (GitHub rate limit). Try later.
storage.backupHint: A single HTML file that opens in any browser, offline and without sign-in: team and agent rankings per quarter, notification log, daily snapshots, and the full raw data inside.
storage.backupDone: Backup downloaded. Keep it somewhere safe (e.g. Google Drive).
storage.excelToo: Or download the year’s Excel file from “Import & export”
storage.cleanHint: Deletes old supporting data only, to keep the board fast. Take a backup first.
storage.snapshotsNote: Trend charts and rank arrows for deleted quarters will no longer show.
storage.cleanSafe: Sales, targets, teams and agents are never deleted, and current-quarter data is protected.
storage.confirmCleanup: The selected data will be permanently deleted. Continue?
storage.confirmNoBackup: You have not downloaded a backup this session, and deletion is permanent. Continue without a backup?
storage.cleanDone: Done: removed {events} notifications, {snapshots} snapshots, {sync} sync entries, {photos} photos.
storage.demoNoClean: The demo account is view-only — cleanup is for admins.
